summary: Admin Network Settings feature fully tested. All backend APIs (9/9 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. Settings tab shows 'Game Networks' section with toggles for GamePix and GameMonetize. Disabling a network hides its tab from the admin dashboard. Warning message appears when both networks are disabled.

Backend: POST /api/admin/settings requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
Backend: Save gamepix_enabled = true persists correctly
Backend: Save gamepix_enabled = false persists correctly
Backend: Save gamemonetize_enabled = true persists correctly
Backend: Save gamemonetize_enabled = false persists correctly
Backend: Save both network settings in one request works
Backend: Settings persist correctly after multiple saves
Frontend: Admin dashboard loads correctly with all 7 tabs when both networks enabled
Frontend: Settings tab shows 'Game Networks' section with Gamepad2 icon
Frontend: GamePix toggle found with data-testid='gamepix-toggle'
Frontend: GameMonetize toggle found with data-testid='gamemonetize-toggle'
Frontend: Toggle states correctly show 'checked' when enabled
Frontend: Clicking GamePix toggle changes state to 'unchecked'
Frontend: Save button saves settings successfully

Frontend: After disabling both networks, warning message appears: 'All game networks are disabled. You can still upload custom games.'
Frontend: After re-enabling both networks, all 7 tabs visible again
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Network Settings feature is fully implemented and working. Settings tab in admin dashboard has 'Game Networks' section with Switch toggles for GamePix and GameMonetize. Settings are persisted via POST /api/admin/settings as string values ('true'/'false'). GET /api/settings returns gamepix_enabled and gamemonetize_enabled. When a network is disabled, its tab is conditionally hidden from the admin dashboard tabs. Warning message appears when both networks are disabled. Switch component uses @radix-ui/react-switch at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/switch.tsx.
